Domain

Highest bid

The current highest bid.

Action

End of auction

A date or the remaining time until when this domain's auction will end.

Count bids

The number of bids on this domain.

inTld Count

Indicates the number of Tlds that also have the same domain name. A list of the Tlds taken into account can be found in the FAQ.

Majestic RD

The number of domains referencing this domain name.

Majestic Backlinks

The number of backlinks pointing to this domain.

Majestic Trust Flow

The Trust Flow belongs to the so-called Majestic Flow Metrics and determines a value based on the number of inbound links from reputable, trustworthy websites. The higher the value, the more high quality inbound links the URL or domain has.

Majestic Citation Flow

The Citation Flow belongs to the so-called Majestic Flow Metrics and determines a value based on the number of incoming links. The higher the value, the more links the URL or domain has

Majestic TF/CF

Trust flow / citation flow is also known as trust ratio. If a website has many incoming links (high citation flow) from spam pages (low trust flow) the trust ratio is very low. A high trust ratio means more high quality inbound links.

Google hits

Number of Google search results for this domain name.

Dictionary

If the domain name is found in a dictionary of a certain language, the corresponding country flag is displayed. If the flag is transparent, only a partial term was found within the domain name or diacritical marks were removed from the domain name, e.g. "cordoba.se" (correct "córdoba"). If it is the national language of the country-specific Tld, the flag is displayed larger and in the first row. All other languages are shown smaller and in the second row.

ARC

Number of search results in "archive.org".

Number of characters

The number of characters that make up the domain name.
